meanings.en: the ability to make good decisions or form sensible opinions
meanings.exampleEn: She showed excellent judgement in handling the crisis.
meanings.exampleTr: Krizi ele alışında mükemmel bir muhakeme sergiledi.

meanings.en: a decision made by a court of law
meanings.exampleEn: The court will deliver its judgement next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme kararını gelecek hafta açıklayacak.

meanings.tr: mezardan çıkarmak; gömülü bir şeyi kazıp çıkarmak
meanings.en: to dig up something, especially a body, that has been buried
meanings.exampleEn: Investigators decided to disinter the body for a new autopsy.
meanings.exampleTr: Soruşturmacılar yeni bir otopsi için cesedi mezardan çıkarmaya karar verdi.

meanings.tr: göçmen (özellikle siyasi nedenlerle ülkesini terk eden kişi)
meanings.en: a person who has left their country, especially for political reasons
meanings.exampleEn: The novelist was a Russian émigré living in Paris.
meanings.exampleTr: Romancı, Paris'te yaşayan Rus bir göçmendi.

meanings.en: to force or throw something out, usually suddenly
meanings.exampleEn: The machine will eject the disc when you press the button.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğmeye bastığınızda makine diski dışarı çıkaracak.

meanings.en: to force someone to leave a place
meanings.exampleEn: Two fans were ejected from the stadium for fighting.
meanings.exampleTr: İki taraftar kavga ettikleri için stadyumdan çıkarıldı.

meanings.en: to send someone away from a place as a punishment
meanings.exampleEn: The king decided to banish the rebel from the kingdom.
meanings.exampleTr: Kral isyancıyı krallıktan sürgün etmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: to get rid of a thought or feeling
meanings.exampleEn: Try to banish all negative thoughts from your mind.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm olumsuz düşünceleri zihninden uzaklaştırmaya çalış.

meanings.en: to end or cause something to end
meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to terminate the contract early.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket sözleşmeyi erken sona erdirmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: to end someone's employment
meanings.exampleEn: They had to terminate several employees during the downturn.
meanings.exampleTr: Durgunluk döneminde birkaç çalışanın işine son vermek zorunda kaldılar.

meanings.en: able to be said or expressed in words
meanings.exampleEn: Some feelings are barely utterable in everyday language.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı duygular gündelik dilde neredeyse dile getirilemez.

meanings.en: the quality of expressing or arousing strong feelings
meanings.exampleEn: The emotiveness of her speech moved the whole audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşmasının duygusallığı tüm dinleyicileri etkiledi.

meanings.en: the state of being empty or without expression
meanings.exampleEn: A look of blankness crossed his face when I asked the question.
meanings.exampleTr: Soruyu sorduğumda yüzünde bir ifadesizlik belirdi.

meanings.en: the quality of not showing emotion or reaction
meanings.exampleEn: The judge listened with complete impassivity.
meanings.exampleTr: Yargıç tam bir ifadesizlikle dinledi.

meanings.en: to practise a play, performance or speech before presenting it
meanings.exampleEn: The actors rehearse the scene several times before the show.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncular gösteriden önce sahneyi birkaç kez prova ederler.

meanings.en: able to be changed to suit particular needs
meanings.exampleEn: The chair has an adjustable backrest for extra comfort.
meanings.exampleTr: Sandalyenin ekstra konfor için ayarlanabilir bir sırt desteği var.

meanings.en: to destroy something completely
meanings.exampleEn: A single bomb could annihilate the entire city.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek bir bomba tüm şehri yok edebilirdi.

meanings.en: to defeat someone completely in a game or contest
meanings.exampleEn: Our team annihilated the opposition six to nil.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımımız rakibi altı sıfır ezici biçimde yendi.

meanings.en: complete destruction
meanings.exampleEn: The war threatened the annihilation of an entire people.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş, koca bir halkın yok edilmesi tehdidini taşıyordu.

meanings.en: satisfied (of thirst) or extinguished (of fire or heat)
meanings.exampleEn: With his thirst finally quenched, he set down the empty glass.
meanings.exampleTr: Susuzluğu nihayet giderilince boş bardağı yere bıraktı.

meanings.en: soaked with liquid, or with a flame put out
meanings.exampleEn: The doused campfire still gave off a thin trail of smoke.
meanings.exampleTr: Söndürülmüş kamp ateşi hâlâ ince bir duman çıkarıyordu.

meanings.en: provided with light, or set burning
meanings.exampleEn: The room was warmly lit by a single lamp.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda tek bir lambayla sıcak bir şekilde aydınlatılmıştı.

meanings.en: set on fire or caused to start burning
meanings.exampleEn: The ignited fuel burst into a bright flame.
meanings.exampleTr: Tutuşturulan yakıt parlak bir alevle alev aldı.

meanings.tr: bu dünyaya ait olmayan, esrarengiz, öteki dünyaya özgü
meanings.en: seeming to belong to another, imaginary or spiritual world
meanings.exampleEn: The forest had an otherworldly, dreamlike quality at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Orman şafak vakti öteki dünyaya ait, rüya gibi bir hava taşıyordu.

meanings.tr: sosyal, cana yakın, insan arasında olmayı seven
meanings.en: liking to be with other people; sociable
meanings.exampleEn: She is a gregarious person who loves parties.
meanings.exampleTr: O, partileri seven sosyal bir insandır.

meanings.en: shy and more interested in your own thoughts than in socialising
meanings.exampleEn: As an introverted child, he preferred reading to playing outside.
meanings.exampleTr: İçe dönük bir çocuk olarak dışarıda oynamaktansa okumayı tercih ederdi.

meanings.en: to make a dish or drink by mixing various ingredients
meanings.exampleEn: He concocted a strange soup from whatever was in the fridge.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzdolabında ne varsa ondan garip bir çorba hazırladı.

meanings.en: to invent a story or plan, especially to deceive
meanings.exampleEn: They concocted an excuse to explain their absence.
meanings.exampleTr: Yokluklarını açıklamak için bir bahane uydurdular.

meanings.en: a person who leads a discussion or debate and keeps it orderly
meanings.exampleEn: The moderator asked each candidate the same question.
meanings.exampleTr: Moderatör her adaya aynı soruyu sordu.

meanings.en: a person who checks online content to ensure the rules are followed
meanings.exampleEn: A forum moderator removed the offensive comment.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir forum moderatörü saldırgan yorumu kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a person who tries to help two sides settle a dispute
meanings.exampleEn: A neutral mediator helped the two companies reach an agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarafsız bir arabulucu iki şirketin anlaşmaya varmasına yardım etti.

meanings.en: a person or thing that blocks or hinders progress
meanings.exampleEn: He was seen as an obstructor of the reform process.
meanings.exampleTr: Reform sürecinin bir engelleyicisi olarak görülüyordu.

meanings.en: writing that is about real facts and events, not imaginary ones
meanings.exampleEn: She mostly reads non-fiction, especially history and biography.
meanings.exampleTr: Çoğunlukla kurgu dışı, özellikle tarih ve biyografi okur.

meanings.en: the quality of being confident and not afraid to take risks
meanings.exampleEn: Her boldness in challenging the board impressed everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim kuruluna meydan okumadaki cesareti herkesi etkiledi.

meanings.en: loyalty and faithfulness to a person, cause or belief
meanings.exampleEn: He was praised for his fidelity to the company over thirty years.
meanings.exampleTr: Otuz yıl boyunca şirkete olan sadakati nedeniyle övüldü.

meanings.en: the degree to which something is accurately copied or reproduced
meanings.exampleEn: The recording reproduces the concert with remarkable fidelity.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıt, konseri dikkat çekici bir aslına uygunlukla yeniden üretiyor.

meanings.en: the crime of copying something to deceive, or the copy itself
meanings.exampleEn: The painting turned out to be a clever forgery.
meanings.exampleTr: Tablonun ustaca yapılmış bir sahte eser olduğu ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: something that is not what it claims to be; a pretence
meanings.exampleEn: The trial was a sham designed to silence critics.
meanings.exampleTr: Duruşma, eleştirmenleri susturmak için tasarlanmış bir aldatmacaydı.

meanings.en: not genuine; pretended
meanings.exampleEn: They exposed his sham concern for the workers.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçilere yönelik sahte kaygısını ifşa ettiler.

meanings.en: a statement that is not true; a lie
meanings.exampleEn: He was accused of telling an untruth to the committee.
meanings.exampleTr: Komiteye yalan söylemekle suçlandı.

meanings.en: to make an illegal copy of something in order to deceive
meanings.exampleEn: He was jailed for trying to forge a passport.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahte pasaport yapmaya çalıştığı için hapse atıldı.

meanings.en: to create or develop something, especially a relationship
meanings.exampleEn: The two nations forged a strong alliance over the years.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ulus yıllar içinde güçlü bir ittifak kurdu.

meanings.en: a person who has very strong, often extreme, beliefs
meanings.exampleEn: He was a religious zealot who refused any compromise.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiçbir uzlaşmayı reddeden dini bir fanatikti.

meanings.en: the holding of extreme political or religious views
meanings.exampleEn: The government launched a campaign against violent extremism.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet şiddet içeren aşırıcılığa karşı bir kampanya başlattı.

meanings.en: excessive and uncompromising commitment to a cause or belief
meanings.exampleEn: His political zealotry alienated even his closest allies.
meanings.exampleTr: Siyasi fanatikliği en yakın müttefiklerini bile kendinden uzaklaştırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of doing something within sensible limits
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors advise drinking alcohol only in moderation.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar alkolü yalnızca ölçülü tüketmeyi öneriyor.

meanings.en: able to see things clearly only when they are close
meanings.exampleEn: She is near-sighted and cannot read road signs from a distance.
meanings.exampleTr: O miyop ve uzaktan trafik levhalarını okuyamıyor.

meanings.en: lacking foresight; not considering future consequences
meanings.exampleEn: It was a near-sighted policy that ignored long-term costs.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun vadeli maliyetleri göz ardı eden dar görüşlü bir politikaydı.

meanings.en: in a way that is not currently popular or in style
meanings.exampleEn: He remained unfashionably optimistic about the economy.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonomi konusunda modaya aykırı biçimde iyimser kaldı.

meanings.en: the condition of being very overweight in an unhealthy way
meanings.exampleEn: Childhood obesity has become a serious health concern.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukluk çağı obezitesi ciddi bir sağlık sorunu haline geldi.

meanings.en: the quality of being pleasantly round and slightly fat
meanings.exampleEn: The plumpness of the baby's cheeks made everyone smile.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeğin yanaklarının tombulluğu herkesi gülümsetti.

meanings.en: continually finding fault in a petty or annoying way
meanings.exampleEn: I'm tired of his carping criticism of everything I do.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaptığım her şeye yönelik dırdırcı eleştirilerinden bıktım.

meanings.en: the practice of giving jobs or advantages to your own relatives
meanings.exampleEn: The company was accused of nepotism after hiring the CEO's son.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, CEO'nun oğlunu işe aldıktan sonra akraba kayırmakla suçlandı.

meanings.tr: uygulanabilir biçimde, olabildiğince (pratik açıdan mümkün olduğunca)
meanings.en: in a way that is possible to do or put into practice
meanings.exampleEn: Please respond as soon as practicably possible.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen uygulanabilir olan en kısa sürede yanıt verin.

meanings.en: in a way that is sensible and based on what is actually possible
meanings.exampleEn: Realistically, we can't finish the whole project by Friday.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçekçi olmak gerekirse, tüm projeyi cumaya kadar bitiremeyiz.

meanings.en: in a way that represents things as they really are
meanings.exampleEn: The film portrays war realistically and without glamour.
meanings.exampleTr: Film savaşı gerçekçi biçimde ve süslemeden tasvir ediyor.

meanings.en: the quality of producing good or useful results
meanings.exampleEn: The fruitfulness of the collaboration surprised both teams.
meanings.exampleTr: İş birliğinin verimliliği her iki ekibi de şaşırttı.
